description: Fixed quality-benchmark case set (Task 14 / brief 15). Consumed by scripts/quality_eval.py; cases are frozen so CER/WER and speaker-similarity rows stay comparable across runs. The clone case reuses the bundled license-clean synthetic reference clip (fully reproducible via scripts/make_ref_wav.py); its ref_text is the documented approximate transcript of that clip (see tests/test_voice_clone_workflow.py and scripts/benchmark.py). The clone case is cross-lingual by design: an English-language synthetic reference driven to Chinese text, the officially supported path exercised by the multilingual matrix evidence.
